amershi-2019.title: Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction
amershi-2019.note: Connects human needs, feedback and responsible AI behaviour to the Design foundation.

sculley-2015.title: Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems
sculley-2015.note: Explains dependencies, feedback loops and maintainability across Develop and Manage.

atkinson-1999.title: Project management: cost, time and quality, two best guesses and a phenomenon, its time to accept other success criteria
atkinson-1999.note: Connects project success with stakeholder benefits and performance indicators beyond cost, time and quality.

anbari-2003.title: Earned Value Project Management Method and Extensions
anbari-2003.note: Connects planning with monitoring, forecasting and corrective action through earned value.

zha-2023.title: Data-centric Artificial Intelligence: A Survey
zha-2023.note: Surveys training-data development, inference data and data maintenance across the AI lifecycle.

sambasivan-2021.title: "Everyone wants to do the model work, not the data work": Data Cascades in High-Stakes AI
sambasivan-2021.note: Shows how data quality issues propagate through AI development and affect downstream outcomes.

bommasani-2021.title: On the Opportunities and Risks of Foundation Models
bommasani-2021.note: Introduces the foundation-model framing, covering capabilities, adaptation, opportunities and risks.

kaplan-2020.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
kaplan-2020.note: Relates language-model performance to model size, dataset size and training compute.

wolf-2020.title: Transformers: State-of-the-Art Natural Language Processing
wolf-2020.note: Describes the Transformers library and the reuse of pretrained language models.

mitchell-2019.title: Model Cards for Model Reporting
mitchell-2019.note: Supports model selection through documentation of intended uses, evaluation and limitations.

vaswani-2017.title: Attention Is All You Need
vaswani-2017.note: Provides the Transformer and attention mechanisms underlying modern language models.

brown-2020.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
brown-2020.note: Connects autoregressive language modelling with few-shot learning across diverse tasks.

pan-yang-2010.title: A Survey on Transfer Learning
pan-yang-2010.note: Clarifies source and target domains and tasks, and the relationship between transfer learning and domain adaptation.

hu-2022.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
hu-2022.note: Explains adaptation through small low-rank updates while pretrained weights remain frozen.
